metadata.title: Set-NextOneTimeBootVirtualMediaDeviceOemREDFISH
metadata.description: iDRAC cmdlet using Redfish API with OEM extension to set next onetime boot device to either virtual optical or virtual floppy. DMTF does not support setting virtual CD or virtual floppy as next one time boot. This cmdlet uses OEM extension to solve this issue.

findings.title: Plain text is converted to a secure string
findings.description: File 'file-00002.psm1' uses ConvertTo-SecureString with plaintext. This will expose secure information. Encrypted standard strings should be used instead.

findings.title: Separate username and password parameters are declared
findings.description: Function 'Set-NextOneTimeBootVirtualMediaDeviceOemREDFISH' has both Username and Password parameters. Either set the type of the Password parameter to SecureString or replace the Username and Password parameters with a Credential parameter of type PSCredential. If using a Credential parameter in PowerShell 4.0 or earlier, please define a credential transformation attribute after the PSCredential type attribute.

findings.title: Plain text password parameter is declared
findings.description: Parameter '$idrac_password' should not use String type but either SecureString or PSCredential, otherwise it increases the chance to expose this sensitive information.
